title: Vengeance on the Midianites
description: The Lord commands Moses to take vengeance on the Midianites before he dies. An army of twelve thousand men, led by Phinehas, goes to war, kills all the men and the five Midianite kings, and also Balaam son of Beor. Women and children are taken captive. Moses is angry that the women have been spared, and commands that all male children and every woman who has slept with a man be killed, while the young girls are to be kept alive. The warriors and captives are purified for seven days, and the plunder is divided between the warriors and the congregation. A contribution is given to the priest Eleazar and the Levites. Finally, the officers bring gold jewelry as an atonement offering to the Lord.
